description: The file is a PHP source code for the class Opencart.Admin.Controller.Design.Theme, which manages theme-related actions in the admin panel of OpenCart. It includes methods for listing themes, editing themes, loading themes, and rendering related views, along with handling breadcrumbs, pagination, and form data.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for managing themes in the OpenCart admin panel. Handles listing, editing, creating, and deleting themes, and managing theme templates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of themes, initialize breadcrumbs, load themes from the model, and render the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of themes, primarily for AJAX or partial reloads.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the complete list view for themes, including pagination, breadcrumbs, and theme data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles displaying the form for creating or editing a theme, including loading existing theme data if editing.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Loads a specific theme template, either default or extension, with support for Twig or other template engines.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving theme data, including creating new themes or editing existing ones, and returning success or error responses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deleting selected themes, ensuring user permission and returning success or error responses.
